notes: OpenCode 2.x through the service API (#2109 P5b-2). Two gated calls on one session, one per turn: a write (edit ask) and a read (read ask). Each holds the session in waiting while its ask is pending (the plugin's permission.asked), and each turn ends ready after the API reply. No post-reply working is asserted (#1366 dwell, as in 2-19).

text: The API session is admitted when its first activity lands (P3, #2107): a ses_… transcript_new. Its first state is not pinned — an API session is first seen working (P4; P5a's smoke cells)
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
Turn 1 (the mutating write) drives the session to working
The plugin forwards the write's permission.asked
The held edit ask puts the session in waiting (rule 0: PermissionPending)
After the reply turn 1 completes to ready; no post-reply working is asserted (#1366 dwell)
Turn 2 (the read-only read) drives the session to working
The plugin forwards the read's permission.asked — the read-only tool is gated the same way
The held read ask puts the session in waiting, exactly as the mutating ask did
After the reply turn 2 completes to ready
